Small and intimate weddings are also catered for!
Contact us should you need more information or if you would like to make a booking, our friendly staff and owners will gladly assist!

About Mooiplaasie | Safe Bush Retreat for Women & Families
Tranquil retreat nestled in the heart of the Dinokeng Game Reserve
About Us
Welcome to Mooiplasie Bush Camp
Welcome to Mooiplasie Bush Camp, your tranquil retreat nestled in the heart of the Dinokeng Game Reserve, just a short drive north of Pretoria.
Mooiplaasie Bush Camp is more than just a getaway — it’s a safe bush retreat for solo women , couples, and families looking to reconnect with nature. Nestled in tranquil bushveld, we offer a quiet escape perfect for birdwatching , stargazing , and nights by the campfire .
Our self-catering establishment is a beloved destination for families, schools, church groups, and companies seeking a peaceful getaway, training camps, or business conferences.
We also specialize in hosting small and intimate weddings, providing a unique and memorable setting for your special day.
Who we are
Mooiplasie Bush Camp is more than just a place to stay; it s an opportunity to immerse yourself in the beauty and tranquility of the bushveld. Our camp offers a range of activities and experiences that allow you to connect with nature and create lasting memories.
Whether you re lighting a bonfire under the stars, spotting wildlife on a game drive, or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings, our camp offers a true escape from the hustle and bustle of city life.
Perfect for women traveling alone who want a safe, quiet bush retreat.
Our Accomodation
At MooiPlasie Bush Camp, we offer a variety of comfortable and fully furnished chalets.
Each chalet is thoughtfully designed to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings, offering you a cozy and inviting space to unwind. Whether you re looking for a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a group retreat, our chalets provide the perfect home away from home.
Families and couples love Mooiplaasie for its natural beauty and peaceful energy.

Our commitment to you
At Mooiplasie Bush Camp, we are committed to providing you with an exceptional experience. Our friendly staff and owners are always ready to assist you with any inquiries or bookings, ensuring that your stay is comfortable and enjoyable. We take pride in offering a warm and welcoming atmosphere, where you can relax, recharge, and reconnect with nature.
Whether you enjoy stargazing or sipping coffee while birdwatching , this is your space to breathe.
